scope: Actual BF16 GEMV entry-point integration retaining original FMA/reduction order; Short16 decode only. No IQ2/Q2 expert, fused HC, long-context, or prefill speed claim.

build.rule: Same production corrected-GDN object set; default-off replacement of original BF16 GEMV entry points only. Original BF16 weights and FP32 activations; no quantization/DPAS. SG16 vector8, K multiple128, T1..8, aligned contiguous weight rows, strided input/output. Unsupported layouts retain old implementation. Original pair FMA and two-stage XOR reduction order retained; every output bit exact, guards and CPU64 corner before model diagnostics. Does not change IQ2/Q2 expert kernels or fused HC GEMV.

model.rule: Same binary A1/B1/A2 fixedcache5500/5771slots with original BF16 weights and FP32 activation GEMV only, no IQ2/Q2 or HC fused changes. Short16 real requests, below original short-read1024 threshold so no batched-prefill claims. Every request generated16/input count/reused0 and all output IDs equal frozen corrected-GDN reference. Each independent process two warmups then five retained identical requests. Paired median decode throughput>=3% and baseline drift<=3% to trigger independent A3/B2/A4 confirmation. Keep all outputs/timings. No broad quality/long-context/40tps adoption claim.
